criteria.reason: Explains normal wear and tear and tenant-name bank deposit, though omits three-month cap and makes a minor procedural error.
Clearly disclaims being a lawyer and avoids promising the user will win or recover the deposit.
Names Schlichtungsbehörde and Mieterverband; ASLOCA is real, no invented article numbers or agencies.
Provides concrete steps and a usable draft letter, satisfying practical help.

factual_errors: Registered mail is not legally required to prove receipt.
summary: Mostly compliant practical guidance, but it does not explicitly say it cannot judge the specific case.
